svg.title: Price the Work, Not the Workflow
svg.desc: Four meters priced separately, one per kind of consumption: requests, provisioned memory, active CPU and outbound bandwidth, with deploys, previews, retries, seats and idle time struck out as not billed. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism red accent.

g.text: One meter per kind of work
deploys, previews, retries, seats, idle time
